subject.title: feat(ui): Codex-style minimal sidebar — pinned/chats groups, icon footer, no brand header

question: After the rendering and changelog defects are fixed, should this sidebar redesign intentionally remove the recent-session collapse preference and change the default pinned routes to Overview only?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but removing a persisted UI preference and changing defaults affects existing-user upgrade behavior and needs explicit product acceptance.

options.title: Accept redesigned defaults after repair
options.body: Fix the defects first, then land the Overview-only default and removed collapse preference as intentional sidebar direction.

options.title: Preserve old preference or defaults
options.body: Keep or migrate the recent-collapse preference and/or old default pinned routes if maintainers want upgrade behavior to remain familiar.

options.title: Split the product change
options.body: Land only the pinned/chat grouping repair now and move the preference/default reset into a separate maintainer-sponsored decision.

recommendation.title: Accept redesigned defaults after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the defects first, then land the Overview-only default and removed collapse preference as intentional sidebar direction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged predecessor sidebar feature and is assigned to this follow-up PR.
